pages.text: Stone cup holds and serves 250 mB. Use it for coffee.
Wooden mug holds 500 mB in two 250 mB servings. Suitable for many brews.
Glass chalice holds and serves 200 mB.
Shot glass holds and serves 40 mB, with a shorter drinking animation.
The mod bottle holds 2,000 mB and serves 250 mB at a time.
A syringe holds 10 mB and works only with injectable fluids.

pages.title: Vanilla Containers
pages.text: Glass bottle holds and serves 125 mB. A bowl holds and serves 50 mB. A bucket holds 1,000 mB for transport. Use a vessel with a full serving, then hold use until it finishes.

pages.title: Know Your Cup
pages.text: Recipes and machines check vessel compatibility. A wooden mug refuses coca tea, cannabis tea, peyote juice, kava and flower extracts. For teas and extracts, use a suitable glass chalice or mod bottle.
